name: ericboehs-agent-plugins
description: Agent plugins by Eric Boehs — session analysis, workflow automation, and developer productivity tools

plugins.name: session-improver
plugins.description: Analyze Claude Code sessions to find token waste, linter loops, and missing automations, then recommend and apply fixes

plugins.name: apple-reminders
plugins.description: Manage Apple Reminders from Claude Code using remindctl CLI

plugins.name: cli-email
plugins.description: CLI email management using himalaya, mbsync, and neomutt with local Maildir sync and search. One-time install lives in the cli-email-setup companion plugin.

plugins.name: cli-email-setup
plugins.description: One-time install and configuration of the CLI email stack (mbsync, himalaya, neomutt, goimapnotify) for the cli-email plugin. Enable only when bootstrapping a new machine.

plugins.name: apple-calendar
plugins.description: Manage Apple Calendar from Claude Code using ical CLI with full CRUD, search, and calendar filtering. One-time install lives in the apple-calendar-setup companion plugin.

plugins.name: apple-calendar-setup
plugins.description: One-time install and configuration of the ical CLI for the apple-calendar plugin. Enable only when bootstrapping a new machine.

plugins.name: slack
plugins.description: Slack messaging, status, and search using slk CLI (Slack Gem). One-time install lives in the slack-setup companion plugin.

plugins.name: slack-setup
plugins.description: One-time install and configuration of the slk CLI (Slack Gem) for the slack plugin. Enable only when bootstrapping a new machine.

plugins.name: code-lint
plugins.description: Multi-language linting via PostToolUse hooks with per-project config. Interactive setup lives in the code-lint-setup companion plugin.

plugins.name: code-lint-setup
plugins.description: One-time interactive setup wizard for the code-lint plugin — detects languages and linters and writes per-project config. Enable only when bootstrapping a machine or project.

plugins.name: git-utils
plugins.description: Git workflow utilities — merge PRs, clean up branches, and handle worktrees in one command

plugins.name: icloud-downloads
plugins.description: Copy files to iCloud Downloads for easy access on iPhone/iPad

plugins.name: gist
plugins.description: Create and update GitHub Gists with auto-generated README comments

plugins.name: unanet
plugins.description: Automate Unanet timesheet entry via Playwright and Okta SSO with 1Password credentials. One-time install lives in the unanet-setup companion plugin.

plugins.name: unanet-setup
plugins.description: One-time setup of the unanet CLI and 1Password-backed credentials for the unanet timesheet plugin. Enable only when bootstrapping a new machine.

plugins.name: dev-lifecycle
plugins.description: Full feature development lifecycle — plan, implement, test, review, PR, Copilot review, verify CI, QA demo, merge, and clean up in one command

plugins.name: gh-copilot-review
plugins.description: Wait for GitHub Copilot PR reviews, address feedback, resolve threads, and push fixes

plugins.name: watch-ci
plugins.description: Monitor GitHub Actions CI status for the current branch, auto-exit on pass or fail

plugins.name: agent-desktop
plugins.description: Drive macOS apps via the accessibility tree using the agent-desktop CLI — observe with snapshots, act on element refs. One-time install lives in the agent-desktop-setup companion plugin.

plugins.name: agent-desktop-setup
plugins.description: One-time install and configuration of the agent-desktop CLI for macOS accessibility automation, honoring aube supply-chain hardening. Enable only when bootstrapping a machine; companion to the agent-desktop plugin.

plugins.name: copy-for-slack
plugins.description: Convert the last assistant message from Markdown to Slack-compatible formatting and copy it to the clipboard

plugins.name: gh-actions-security
plugins.description: Security checklist for GitHub Actions workflows — SHA pinning, least-privilege permissions, zizmor linting, and repo hardening

plugins.name: x-fetch
plugins.description: Retrieve X/Twitter content Claude can't otherwise read — tweet text and media via fxtwitter, gated long-form articles via Safari AppleScript

plugins.name: md-to-pdf
plugins.description: Convert GitHub-flavored markdown to a PDF that looks like github.com's rendering, using pandoc and headless Chrome

plugins.name: pptx
plugins.description: Generate and edit PowerPoint decks with pptxgenjs, including the render-and-inspect QA loop that catches layout breakage

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Comprehensive PR review that fans out specialized reviewers (code, tests, errors, types, comments, simplify, security) as concurrent isolated agents, then aggregates findings into a prioritized report

plugins.name: security-review
plugins.description: Security review of branch changes: an Anthropic-derived reviewer and deterministic scanners (gitleaks, brakeman, zizmor, bundle-audit, npm audit) run as isolated agents, then an independent verifier tries to disprove every candidate before it is reported
